formulas.M_s(d): leave-one-out mean over the other 4 symbols' dlogs; for MA: M = +/-ln1.5/4 (MB carries the whole aggregate)
formulas.SH_s: mean own share over the 4 most recent daily rows (4,5,6,7); up-row aggregate = 200+150+100+100+100 = 650, down-row = 500, so SH_MA = (200/650 + 100/500)/2, SH_MB = (150/650 + 100/500)/2, SH_MC=SH_MD=SH_ME = (100/650 + 100/500)/2
formulas.boundary: a row stamped exactly T is readable (<= T); the same row stamped T+1ns is NOT (availability shifts the window one row earlier, deterministically)
formulas.dlog: dlog_s(d) = ln(OI_s(d)/OI_s(d-1)) at end-row d; MA = +/-ln2, MB = +/-ln1.5, others 0
formulas.slope_s: Cov(dlog_s, M)/Var(M) over the 3 most recent paired changes (rows 5,6,7); with own = +/-c and M = +/-c_other/4 perfectly in phase, slope = 4*ln2/ln1.5 for MA and 4*ln1.5/ln2 for MB; zero-variance own paths give slope exactly 0.0
formulas.window_refusal: any window_rows < 3 (fewer than 2 paired changes) must raise ContractViolation; a 29-row frozen window at this stamp must fail closed (only 7 rows exist)

levels.MA: amplitude ln2: OI alternates 100,200,100,200,... (up on even rows)
levels.MB: amplitude ln1.5: OI alternates 100,150,100,150,... (up on even rows)
